handoff.summary: Themes plan is implemented and verified. The token contract lives in resources/css/app.css with complete light and dark blocks for coastal, sunset, forest, midnight, and sandstone. Add a sixth theme by editing resources/js/types/ui.ts, resources/js/lib/themes.ts, app/Enums/Theme.php, and resources/css/app.css. Runtime state lives in resources/js/composables/useTheme.ts; persistence touches users.theme, settings/theme via ThemeController, the theme cookie, HandleInertiaRequests shared props, HandleAppearance view shares, and resources/views/app.blade.php data-theme first paint. The cookie is the SSR source of truth; the DB column is authoritative for signed-in users on new devices.
